scripts.generate:all: npm run build && node dist/index.js all
scripts.generate:smart: npm run build && node dist/index.js all -- --skip-passing
scripts.generate:force: npm run build && node dist/index.js all -- --force
scripts.test:cache: npm run build && node dist/index.js cache-stats
scripts.test:clear-cache: npm run build && node dist/index.js clear-cache
scripts.fix: npm run build && node dist/index.js fix
scripts.fix:all: npm run generate:smart && npm run fix
scripts.fix:force: npm run generate:force && npm run fix -- --force
scripts.list-models: npm run build && node dist/index.js list-models
